answer: Run a canyon market per identity: anyone may stake for or against it. To open a short, an accuser posts a 20-token bond with a signed evidence claim. If short interest passes 100 tokens or 30% of the identity's stake, an independent audit starts; failure burns the identity's stake and pays short sellers, while clearance forfeits the bond to the identity. Honest agents pay nothing, but a farmer with 100 fakes must out-bet the market on each one, so cost grows per fake. The fable of independent fakes collapses from a knoll view: shared funders and lockstep timing reveal one operator.
